questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates the ability to implement tenant-isolated behavior using sidecar patterns and ConfigMap-driven configuration, ensuring no cross-tenant impact while maintaining per-tenant control over canary deployment parameters.

## Key Concepts

- Namespace-scoped configuration through ConfigMap volume mounting
- Lightweight per-tenant canary routing implementation
- Traffic management via sidecar proxy pattern
- JSON-based configuration parsing and validation
- Percentage-based traffic distribution algorithms

## Code Example

```yaml
# Canary configuration ConfigMap
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: canary-config
  namespace: tenant-1
data:
  canary.json: |
    {"percent":20,"enabled":true}
---
# Sidecar deployment with ConfigMap mount
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: canary-sidecar
  namespace: tenant-1
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: canary-sidecar
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: canary-sidecar
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: sidecar
        image: canary-router:latest
        volumeMounts:
        - name: canary-config
          mountPath: /etc/cnf
      volumes:
      - name: canary-config
        configMap:
          name: canary-config
```

## Why This Is Asked
Assesses ability to design tenant-isolated feature flagging and traffic-splitting at the CNF edge with CRDs and sidecar routing, including rollback and observability.

- per-tenant traffic shaping; CRD-backed policy; stable hash routing; zero-downtime rollout; observability and rollback.

## Code Example
```yaml
# CRD
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: tenantcanaries.example.org
spec:
  group: example.org
  versions:
  - name: v1
    served: true
    storage: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              tenantID:
                type: string
              canaryPercent:
                type: integer
              canaryService:
                type: string
              prodService:
                type: string
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: tenantcanaries
    singular: tenantcanary
    kind: TenantCanary
```

```go
} else {
  route = prodService
}
```

## Adaptive Sampling Implementation
```go
func AdaptiveSampler(sampleRate float64, errorRate float64) float64 {
    baseRate := sampleRate
    if errorRate > 0.05 {
        return min(1.0, baseRate*2)
    }
    return baseRate
}
```
